# antigravity-doctor

> Zero-dependency diagnostic CLI, Top-8 subdirectory disk breakdown analyzer, safe orphan `.tmp` pruner (`--prune-tmp` / `--dry-run`), and standalone HTML reporter for Google Antigravity IDE and CLI (`agy`). Detects storage bloat, safely cleans orphan `*.pb.*.tmp` / `*.pbtxt.*.tmp` state files, audits installed `SKILL.md` files for indirect prompt injection or leaked secrets, and checks API/GitHub reachability.
